Bill.BriefDescription: Relating to electronic scratch ticket gaming.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the approval, licensing, and playing ofelectronic scratch ticket games and systems by bona fide charitable ornonprofit organizations; persons, associations, or organizationsoperating a business primarily engaged in the selling of food or drinkfor consumption on the premises; phase II housebanked card roomsoperating at least five housebanked card tables; and class 1 horseracing facilities in operation for at least one year.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act shall be known as the electronicscratch ticket gaming act of 2003.
